newsitem.title: SPAIN: Adolfo Dominguez offer 112 times oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Adolfo Dominguez offer 112 times oversubscribed.

text.p: The initial public offer of a 70 percent stake in Spain's fashion house Adolfo Dominguez was widely oversubscribed, with demand 112 times the offer, or 1.8 trillion pesetas, a spokesman said on Friday.
The allocation price was set on Thursday at 3,100 pesetas per share, with the retail price set at a lower value of 3,007 pesetas, he added.
Spain's Banco Central Hispano (BCH), acting as global co-ordinator, said there was no change in the initial allotment plans.
Each retail buyer bidding for 10 million pesetas received 14 shares worth a total of 42,098 pesetas.
"A lot of people asked directly for 10 million pesetas, even though they wanted less than 100,000 pesetas. They were already expecting a very high demand," one dealer said.
Adolfo Dominguez shares will start trading on the Madrid stock exchange from Tuesday, March 18. On Friday morning, shares were trading on the grey market at around 4,000 pesetas.
Dealers said they expected a big jump in the share price in the short run after such a heavy demand in the run-up to the flotation.
